svg.aria-label: Three boxes joined by arrows: Lesson 2A, one voice moves; Lesson 2B, both voices move; Lesson 2C, two short sketches.
svg.title: The Week 2 path: three lessons

g.text: Three lessons, one idea at a
Count a distance, then move one note.
Five changes from the same two notes.
The same melody over two lower lines.
How to read this graphic: Follow the arrows
from left to right (top to bottom on a
phone). Each box names the lesson and what
you do in it. The boxes do not give away the
vocabulary; it is introduced in the lessons
